title: TRACE: Memory-Efficient Time Series Class-Incremental Learning via Temporal-Spectral Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.35727v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web-connected sensing applications continuously generate multivariate time series with evolving behavioral categories, making Time Series Class-Incremental Learning (TSCIL) essential for adapting to new classes without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. However, preserving diverse and evolving class distributions under strict privacy and memory constraints remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches often face a trade-off between retaining sufficient historical knowledge for accurate recognition and minimizing the memory required for continual adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose TRACE, a memory-efficient, replay-free framework that preserves class-specific knowledge through generative modeling rather than sample rehearsal. translated_title: TRACE：基于时频重建的内存高效时间序列类增量学习

tldr: TRACE提出了一种内存高效、无需样本重放的时间序列类增量学习框架，通过冻结的时频表示和轻量级类别特定自编码器进行生成式建模来保存类别特定知识，从而在严格隐私与内存约束下避免遗忘。
en_tdlr: TRACE is a memory-efficient, replay-free time series class-incremental learning framework that preserves class-specific knowledge through generative modeling—using a compact frozen temporal-spectral representation and lightweight class-specific autoencoders—to prevent forgetting under strict privacy and memory constraints.
